modules.name: Card Workshop
modules.summary: Architecture baseline at 1c152a65 (2026-10-18), updated for shared case-ledger implementation (2026-10-21). Eight entry points; enter for focused views. Ownership and interfaces are selected from source, not inferred from folders. “Proposed seams” is discussion only. Start with Game systems, then Policy evidence.

modules.name: Workshop shell
modules.summary: Navigation and lazy UI entry points; browser storage stays in presentation adapters. Selects all six games and their policy inspectors. Commands cross into each game’s application layer; React never owns rules.

modules.name: Game systems
modules.summary: Six independent rule systems. Each owns legal commands, content, score, observations and replay meaning. Enter for real shared versus native paths; Hearth and Night Passage expose additional focused views.

modules.name: Shared utilities
modules.summary: Small proven functions: seeded randomness, accepted-command replay, downloads, layout and presentation clocks. Domain timing and content stay game-owned; these helpers are not a universal rules engine.

modules.name: Art workbench
modules.summary: Native Blender authoring, editable artist sources and delivered assets. Exports are consumed by game/viewer presentation; art delivery does not own simulation rules or policy evidence.

modules.name: Repository tools
modules.summary: Node tooling owns study orchestration, source-pinned bundling and maintenance. Trace normalization/session review concerns developer sessions; game policy rollout review lives under Policy evidence.

modules.name: Repo Canvas
modules.summary: External Repo Workbench implementation in repo-kit. Versioned architecture document, local repository operations and MCP App. Hosted chat proposals require explicit Apply to draft then Save map. Standalone preview and stdio probes do not establish native Codex host attachment.

modules.name: Blindside
modules.summary: SHARED policy path: balatro/agent adapter + PolicyFactory → shared recorder/audit/review. Ordinary play: BlindsideApp → useLocalGame/blindsideSession → domain transition. Seed, rules version and accepted commands reconstruct saves. Own public view, scoring and difficulty remain local.

modules.name: Slay the Spire
modules.summary: SHARED policy path: spire/agent adapter + PolicyFactory → shared recorder/audit/review. Ordinary play: SpireApp → useLocalGame/spireSession → combat/map/rewards. Character and Ascension setup, frame-scoped legal menus and score stay game-owned. Enter for command flow.

modules.name: Last Hearth
modules.summary: SHARED policy adoption covers spell-enabled Mixed Rivals (Arena), not every Hearth mode. All eight actors’ commands are journaled; replayDecision reconstructs recorded native spans without rerunning rivals. Classic, recruitment and frozen transports retain separate paths. Enter for those boundaries.

modules.name: Emberwake
modules.summary: SHARED policy path: diablo2/agent adapter + PolicyFactory → shared recorder/audit/review. Own package, campaign sensors and session/replay continuity; first-death policy attempts differ from ordinary resumed play. No forced GameShell/useLocalGame adoption.

modules.name: Dungeon Cartographer
modules.summary: SHARED policy path: cartographer/agent adapter + PolicyFactory → shared recorder/audit/review. Own expedition session, public forecast and legal actions; generated geometry uses shared layout. Its UI owns local save handling rather than the card-game hook.

modules.name: Night Passage
modules.summary: NATIVE policy path: common CLI dispatches to night-passage/policy-cli → PolicyPlayer/controller → native recorder/audit and RolloutReview. Own chronicle, constrained timing and executed controls. Shared DecisionNavigator and artifact input helpers are reused; shared EpisodeAdapter and gzip output are not. Enter for details.

modules.name: Presentation
modules.summary: SpireApp submits playCard/endTurn commands. useLocalGame owns browser persistence and practice selection; selected cards and playback frames are temporary UI state.

modules.name: Session
modules.summary: spireSession wraps validated accepted-command reconstruction. Rejected commands do not enter authoritative replay. Rules versions select replay meaning; browser storage stays outside the pure session.

modules.name: Rules & content
modules.summary: Owns legal transitions, combat/turn order, map, rewards and content IDs. Explicit seeded state drives randomness; pure rules run without React, clocks or storage.

modules.name: Trace normalization
modules.summary: External Repo Workbench implementation in repo-kit. Normalizes local session evidence and produces review documents.

modules.name: Session review
modules.summary: External Repo Workbench implementation in repo-kit. Shared frontend for offline exports and local session review.

modules.name: Maintenance governance
modules.summary: Enforces source checker scope, document placement and artifact retention contracts.

modules.name: Canvas & inspector
modules.summary: External Repo Workbench implementation in repo-kit. Renders the current hierarchy scope, projected relationships and source overlays. Changes remain drafts until saved.

modules.name: Architecture document
modules.summary: External Repo Workbench implementation in repo-kit. One versioned document shared with the agent. Validates hierarchy, IDs, endpoints, annotations and layout.

modules.name: Repository bridge
modules.summary: External Repo Workbench implementation in repo-kit. Loads and saves the shared file with revision checks; previews bounded repo source.

modules.name: Current chat bridge
modules.summary: External Repo Workbench implementation in repo-kit. Hosted MCP App uses ui/initialize, tools/call and ui/message with the owning conversation. canvas_read captures unsaved context; canvas_reply returns answer/proposal. A local harness can test bridge semantics, but cannot establish that the user’s installed Codex sidebar is attached.

modules.name: Policy evidence
modules.summary: Implemented record/audit/review pipeline for five EpisodeAdapters, plus CLI dispatch to Night Passage’s native backend. Enter to follow permitted input → proposal → accepted commands → evidence, then inspect storage defaults.

modules.name: Proposed seams
modules.summary: DISCUSSION ONLY — two bounded consolidation options with adoption conditions and tradeoffs. No new engine, schema or future feature is implemented by this map. Enter and annotate the option before changing code.

modules.name: Policy boundary
modules.summary: Adapter constructs detached public input, binds frame-local menu choices, applies ordinary sessions and returns native metrics. Policies return proposals; they receive neither full state nor the environment seed.

modules.name: Mixed Rivals policy
modules.summary: Current shared adapter = last-hearth-arena. Opaque aliases hide allocation counters; all-actor journal spans let audits replay recorded rival commands. Policy decisions and native commands have different cursors.

modules.name: Recruitment harness
modules.summary: Game-owned recruitment policies and existing headless runtime/inspectors remain supported. They are not automatically equivalent to the restricted adoption observation contract.

modules.name: Classic & frozen APIs
modules.summary: Classic is the ordinary default. Legacy synchronous JSONL agent transports, experiment entry points and historical source hashes retain their recorded meanings; they are separate from the shared adoption recorder. Inspect the owning contract before consolidation.

modules.name: PolicyPlayer
modules.summary: Game-owned player factory receives public PlayerConfig and detached Sight. quick/balanced/deliberate expose deterministic work components; shared PolicyFactory seed/options are not accepted by this CLI path.

modules.name: Controller & chronicle
modules.summary: Constrained observation/action delivery has native timing. Old controls may execute while proposals are delayed/cancelled. Native replay records executed commands; trace records policy knowledge and delivery.

modules.name: Native record & audit
modules.summary: night-passage-rollout-1 keeps native timeline, replay and work semantics. Audits use original controller/rules context. --max-actions includes start; --max-ticks is independent. Native output stays plaintext JSON.

modules.name: Native rollout review
modules.summary: RolloutReview reuses DecisionNavigator and shared artifact input helpers, while interpreting native decisions/chronicle. Native benchmark defaults to summaries; explicit record or --retain-rollouts all retains detail. Legacy --suite is summary-only.

modules.name: CLI & evaluator
modules.summary: Node-only owner: dispatch game, bundle policy/adapters with source/runtime digests, freeze protocol and run cases. Five adapters use withRuntime; Night Passage dispatches to its native backend. Trusted local policy modules are not a hostile-code sandbox.

modules.name: Game adapter
modules.summary: EpisodeAdapter owns create/observe/act/terminal/metrics/cursor/replay/restore. Observe returns permitted game data; act uses native application commands. replayDecision is optional for multi-actor native spans. Five concrete implementations live with their games.

modules.name: Policy
modules.summary: PolicyFactory {id, version, create(config)} returns a decision closure. Input = detached observation; output = {command, work, diagnostics?}. Public setup, independent policySeed/options and per-episode closure memory stay distinct from private environment seed.

modules.name: Record & audit
modules.summary: recordEpisode retains original inputs, raw proposals/rejections, accepted native cursor spans, replay and result. auditRollout checks integrity/replay/input reconstruction/decisions separately; unavailable is not passed. Fairness also needs source and boundary tests.

modules.name: Retained evidence
modules.summary: Enter for the storage decision: routine benchmark summaries versus explicitly retained rollouts. Gzip changes the container only; decoded observations, identities and replay meaning stay intact. Disk savings do not remove transient audit memory.

modules.name: Policy inspector
modules.summary: Five game Review wrappers configure shared PolicyReview with the matching adapter. DecisionNavigator moves among decisions and before/after accepted-command state; policy input and evaluator state remain distinct perspectives. Night Passage owns a native inspector.

modules.name: Benchmark summaries
modules.summary: DEFAULT: protocol, compiled bundle, case outcomes/audit verdicts and complete-study aggregates; transient full input is audited then discarded. Five shared adapters sync each completed summary to cases.jsonl and derive report.json in grid order. Native Night Passage retains its own final-report path. rolloutRetention = none; no detailed-input reopening promise.

modules.name: Selected full rollouts
modules.summary: OPT IN: record one selected episode or benchmark --retain-rollouts all. Five shared adapters write rollout.json.gzip by default; --rollout-format json is explicit. Native Night Passage writes rollout.json and its native manifest/replay/audit. Fresh paths prevent accidental overwrite. Frozen Emberwake strength-validation contracts require retained gzip row.rollout receipts; summary-only reports cannot satisfy that frozen consumer.

modules.name: Container & input
modules.summary: Shared gzip codec retains exact decoded JSON and separate container/decoded hashes. Shared browser artifact input rejects misleading auto-decoded remote .gz bytes; local files retain original bytes. Both inspectors use common size/origin/input contracts; native production still rejects gzip.

modules.name: Iteration retention
modules.summary: Keep policy source/bundle, outcomes, lessons and selected regressions. Superseded bulk input may be deliberately pruned under the owning retention rule; retained historical bytes/hashes are not rewritten by a refactor. This map authorizes no deletion.

modules.name: Completed-case ledger
modules.summary: IMPLEMENTED for the five shared adapters: one parent-owned append and fsync per completed case, validated against a frozen identity grid. Recovery orders rows deterministically, rejects duplicates and marks runs interrupted without a matching final-report success receipt. No partial aggregates, execution resume, extra observations or frozen-validator changes. Native Night Passage remains separate.

modules.name: Proposed: review loading
modules.summary: WHY: codec, navigator and downloads are already shared while inspector loading/error state remains in two owners. On a real loader change, compare a small shared loading hook against two simple vertical paths. COST: native audit/controller errors may diverge; keep schema dispatch, replay timelines and perspectives game-owned. No rewrite of retained inputs.

modules.name: Proposed: game dispatch
modules.summary: WHY: adding a seventh game may touch runtime adapter lookup, CLI wire-name routing and Hub review selection. Consolidate only proven static metadata if those lists drift. COST: mixing browser and Node dependencies would harm lazy bundles. Keep separate loaders and native Night Passage dispatch; no universal engine or policy interface.

connections.label: opens
connections.description: Hub lazy-loads game-owned UI. Each UI delivers native commands to application sessions.

connections.label: opens
connections.description: The workshop exposes DCC viewers as a separate workbench; this does not execute game rules.

connections.label: uses utilities
connections.description: Games selectively reuse replay/RNG/layout/presentation utilities. Night Passage keeps native controller and chronicle semantics.

connections.label: submits command
connections.description: UI invokes application act; persistence saves validated replay, not arbitrary domain snapshots.

connections.label: applies / replays
connections.description: Ordinary commands and accepted-command reconstruction use the game-owned transition boundary.

connections.label: runs studies
connections.description: Tooling bundles five adapters or dispatches to the native Night Passage workflow; it records/audits before reducing retained output.

connections.label: delivers proposal
connections.description: Adapter owns observation/menu binding and metrics; policy cannot mutate rules state.

connections.label: proposes controls
connections.description: Controller delivers according to native observation/delay constraints; a proposal is not an executed command.

connections.label: opens retained input
connections.description: Native inspector interprets native schema; shared navigation does not unify rules or controller semantics.

connections.label: selects runtime
connections.description: withRuntime statically bundles the selected game adapter, builtin/custom policy and recorder with source pins.

connections.label: returns proposal
connections.description: Recorder copies permitted input before invocation; it validates command syntax and delegates accepted execution to adapter.act.

connections.label: opens full rollout
connections.description: Only retained detailed input can be reopened. A digest or summary row alone is not a reconstructable recording.

connections.label: encodes / opens
connections.description: Container format does not change policy-rollout-1 or native replay identities. Native output support and shared input decoding are distinct contracts.

The adapter owns public/private separation and native cursor meaning. Inspect relationship descriptions and source paths for interfaces.

annotations.text: Five shared adapters: Blindside, Spire, Hearth Mixed Rivals, Emberwake, Dungeon Cartographer. Night Passage uses native PolicyPlayer/controller/chronicle/rollout. Shared playing/search APIs expose full seeded state and do not prove restricted-policy fairness. Each game keeps score units, legality and timing.
